inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report: The provider failed to report suspected abuse, neglect, or exploitation directly to the Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline in a timely manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report (26 TAC §746.201(5))

occurrences.finding: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies: The operation did not have an existing Transportation Emergency Plan for evaluation during this inspection. The director drafted a Transportation emergency plan during inspection and presented it to CCR to bring the operation into compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies (26 TAC §746.5619)

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Upon arrival for inspection, infants were observed sitting in high chairs without the manufacturer's required safety straps. The director had the infants taken out of the high chairs and reattached freshly washed straps to the high chairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: Upon arrival at the center for inspection, there was only one caregiver supervising 11 children between the ages of 6 months and 10 years old. Four of the children were under 17 months old. According to minimum standards, one caregiver can supervise only these four infants. However, there were also four additional children aged 18 months to 4 years, and three more children aged 5 years and up.The caregiver was over ratio by caring for 7 additinal children alone.  A second caregiver arrived just a few minutes after I began my inspection, bringing the operation into compliance with ratio standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information obtained, a caregiver did not use good judgment by placing two children in the same crib, which resulted in one child being bitten multiple times by the other.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The infant feeding instructions for a six month old child are not current as they were last updated on 2/5/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
